"""Order lookup endpoints backed by SQLite."""

import sqlite3
from typing import Any

_BASE = (
    "SELECT id, customer, status, total_cents FROM orders "
    "WHERE customer = ? AND status = ? "
)
QUERIES = {
    "newest": _BASE + "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50",
    "total": _BASE + "ORDER BY total_cents DESC LIMIT 50",
}


def list_orders(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection, params: dict[str, str]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    customer = params.get("customer", "")
    status = params.get("status", "open")
    query = QUERIES.get(params.get("sort", "newest"), QUERIES["newest"])
    cursor = conn.execute(query, (customer, status))
    columns = [col[0] for col in cursor.description]
    return [dict(zip(columns, row, strict=True)) for row in cursor.fetchall()]

"""Helpers for summarising git history in the release CLI."""

import re
import shutil
import subprocess

_REF = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*")


def commits_since(tag: str, repo_dir: str) -> list[str]:
    """Return one-line commit summaries between ``tag`` and HEAD."""
    if not _REF.fullmatch(tag):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid tag name: {tag!r}")
    git = shutil.which("git")
    if git is None:
        raise RuntimeError("git executable not found")
    output = subprocess.run(
        [git, "log", "--oneline", f"{tag}..HEAD", "--"],
        cwd=repo_dir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=True,
    ).stdout
    return [line for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()]


def release_notes(tag: str, repo_dir: str) -> str:
    lines = commits_since(tag, repo_dir)
    return "\n".join(f"- {line.split(' ', 1)[-1]}" for line in lines)

"""CSV import for the inventory CLI."""

import csv

EXPECTED_HEADER = ["sku", "name", "quantity"]


def load_inventory(path: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    handle = open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8")
    reader = csv.reader(handle)
    header = next(reader, None)
    if header != EXPECTED_HEADER:
        raise ValueError(f"unexpected header in {path}: {header}")
    stock: dict[str, int] = {}
    for sku, _name, quantity in reader:
        stock[sku] = stock.get(sku, 0) + int(quantity)
    handle.close()
    return stock

import http.client
import json
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


def _post_once(url: str, body: bytes) -> int:
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection(parts.netloc, timeout=5)
    try:
        conn.request(
            "POST",
            parts.path or "/",
            body=body,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        return conn.getresponse().status
    finally:

def deliver(url: str, event: dict[str, object], attempts: int = 3) -> bool:
    body = json.dumps(event).encode()
    for attempt in range(attempts):
        try:

                return True
        except Exception:
            pass

    return True

"""Outbound webhook delivery with retries."""

import http.client
import json
import logging
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _post_once(url: str, body: bytes) -> int:
    parts = urlsplit(url)
    conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection(parts.netloc, timeout=5)
    try:
        conn.request(
            "POST",
            parts.path or "/",
            body=body,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        return conn.getresponse().status
    finally:
        conn.close()


def deliver(url: str, event: dict[str, object], attempts: int = 3) -> bool:
    body = json.dumps(event).encode()
    for attempt in range(attempts):
        try:
            status = _post_once(url, body)
        except (OSError, http.client.HTTPException) as exc:
            log.warning("webhook %s attempt %d failed: %s", url, attempt + 1, exc)
        else:
            if status // 100 == 2:
                return True
            log.warning("webhook %s attempt %d returned %d", url, attempt + 1, status)
        time.sleep(2**attempt)
    return False

"""Attachment download handler."""

import mimetypes
from pathlib import Path

UPLOAD_ROOT = Path("/srv/app/uploads")


def download_attachment(request: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    account_id = request["account_id"]
    name = request["filename"]
    if not account_id.isdigit():
        raise FileNotFoundError(name)
    root = (UPLOAD_ROOT / account_id).resolve()
    path = (root / name).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(root) or not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(name)
    content_type = mimetypes.guess_type(path.name)[0] or "application/octet-stream"
    return path.read_bytes(), content_type

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Generic, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Page(Generic[T]):
    items: list[T]
    page: int
    total_pages: int


def paginate(rows: Sequence[T], page: int, per_page: int = 25) -> Page[T]:
    """Return the 1-indexed ``page`` of ``rows``."""
    if page < 1 or per_page < 1:
        raise ValueError("page and per_page must be positive")

    start = page * per_page
    items = list(rows[start : start + per_page])

"""Pagination helpers for the admin API."""

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Generic, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Page(Generic[T]):
    items: list[T]
    page: int
    total_pages: int


def paginate(rows: Sequence[T], page: int, per_page: int = 25) -> Page[T]:
    """Return the 1-indexed ``page`` of ``rows``."""
    if page < 1 or per_page < 1:
        raise ValueError("page and per_page must be positive")
    total_pages = max(1, -(-len(rows) // per_page))
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    items = list(rows[start : start + per_page])
    return Page(items=items, page=page, total_pages=total_pages)

defmodule LokiPhoenixFixtureWeb.SearchController do
  @moduledoc "Product search endpoint."
  use LokiPhoenixFixtureWeb, :controller

  @default_limit 20
  @max_limit 100

  def index(conn, params) do
    query = params |> Map.get("q", "") |> String.trim()
    limit = params |> Map.get("limit") |> parse_limit()
    json(conn, %{query: query, limit: limit, results: []})
  end

  defp parse_limit(raw) when is_binary(raw) do
    case Integer.parse(raw) do
      {n, ""} when n > 0 -> min(n, @max_limit)
      _ -> @default_limit
    end
  end

  defp parse_limit(_raw), do: @default_limit
end
